title.text: Mrs. Smith Contributed Almost a Quarter of All Donations

source.shows: a design choice that features the insight: the chart type chosen from the message, a fraction of the whole, so a pie, where a quarter is seen at a glance (G1.36, G8.1); Mrs. Smith's slice outlined in the strong shade of its own colour, kept inside the slice, the others unchanged (G7.30, G8.9); the names alone outside the slices, as the book's (labels.parts name, open); the book's taupe for Ms. Flaherty is the palette's fifth colour here, grey being reserved (G4.15)

the book's bad version: columns with Mrs. Smith's darker, which make the reader work out a quarter from the scale; drawn, as the type asked for, with the guided finding that a fraction of the total is a pie's message (G1.36)
